The MACD analysis method also aims to identify market trends by calculating the difference between two exponential moving averages, and assign a trend value from 1 to 10. A value of 1 is considered the strongest indication of the stock price going down, and a value of 10 is the highest indication of the stock price going up. In this case, this analysis method returned a value of 5, indicating a neutral trend for the stock price.

The Fibonacci Retracement analysis method attempts to identify potential support and resistance levels by calculating retracement levels based on previous price movements, and assign a trend value from 1 to 10. A value of 1 is considered the strongest indication of the stock price going down, and a value of 10 is the highest indication of the stock price going up. In this case, this analysis method returned a value of 6, indicating a positive trend for the stock price.

The Bollinger Bands analysis method attempts to identify potential overbought and oversold conditions by calculating a moving average and two standard deviations, and assign a trend value from 1 to 10. A value of 1 is considered the strongest indication of the stock price going down, and a value of 10 is the highest indication of the stock price going up. In this case, this analysis method returned a value of 8, indicating a positive trend for the stock price.

The RSI analysis method attempts to identify potential overbought and oversold conditions by calculating a momentum oscillator, and assign a trend value from 1 to 10.
